svg.title: BLE 3 - Push a song to the singers

g.text: BLE 3 - Push a song to the singers
"Nu" on the song's separator bar [guiDesign D-56]
song document {ref{lib, song, hash}, file, lic}
DEFLATE if it saves ≥ 10 %, frame it, dh/dv [9.5]
state body: seq + 1, ts ↑, cur = ref, title,
docs[3] = {dh, enc, len}, pt; sign with sk [9.4, 10.5]
beacon updated within 100 ms: seq, flags [6.4, FR-BLE-03]
burst: every data set restarts at the changed documents;
state first, then 3 complete passes of the song [7.4]
notify State 0004 (if A is such a delegate)
leader's own page scrolls to the song [guiDesign D-56]
beacon with new seq → expect a new state, start repair timer [10.3]
state frames → verify sig, apply (ts newer)
local library has cur.hash → use that file,
lyric view scrolls to the song, orange bar 1 s,
beacon with new seq → start repair timer
no file with cur.hash → show title, "ontvangen…" [10.3]
or ≤ 984-byte extended frames; bitmap of indices [7.2, 7.5]
group complete → verify dh and SHA-256(file) == cur.hash [FR-BLE-04]
show the lyrics; song added to the session page [guiDesign D-47]
Typical delivery, 2 kB song, no loss:
1 legacy set 12.5 s · 3 sets 4.2 s · extended 0.3 s [7.7]
Target FR-BLE-03 is met by the burst; losses go to scenario 4.
[re-push for singers that report a failed transfer [FR-LEAD-06]]
"Nu" again on the song being sung
seq + 1 without changing the song: 3 more passes;
singers that already have it do nothing [10.5]
